briefings.title: Bessent Says China Was 'Dissenter', Blocking Unanimous G20 Communique (Full Remarks)
briefings.tldr: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that China was the sole dissenter blocking a unanimous G20 communique in Asheville, North Carolina, over disagreements on global trade imbalances and non-market export surpluses.

briefings.title: Commerce Sec. Lutnick and Anthropic co-founder Tom Brown speak at G20 meeting — 9/2/2026
briefings.tldr: AI capabilities and demand are scaling exponentially, driven by systematic compute and data scaling laws that require an unprecedented global industrial buildout of data centers.

briefings.title: FULL INTERVIEW: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Speaks With Howard Lutnick At G20 Ministerial | AI1F
briefings.tldr: AI is a five-layer stack—from energy to data and applications—that democratizes computing and requires every country and enterprise to build local digital infrastructure to capture economic growth.

briefings.title: LIVE: Commerce Sec. Howard Lutnick holds news conference at the G20 Innovation Ministerial — 9/2/26
briefings.tldr: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnik and OSTP Director Michael Kratsios announced a unanimous G20 consensus on the Carolina principles for emerging technology during a press conference in Chapel Hill, North Carolina, emphasizing heavy private sector AI infrastructure investments and the global reach of the American AI stack.

briefings.title: LIVE: OpenAI's Sam Altman speaks at G20 Innovation Ministerial
briefings.tldr: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman argues that AI represents a historic, continuous technological revolution akin to electricity, predicting that making intelligence abundant and inexpensive will fuel an unprecedented boom in global entrepreneurship and education while requiring massive infrastructure investment and proactive risk management.

briefings.title: UN Ambassador Mike Waltz Touts Gaza Plan, Board Of Peace At Munich Security Conference
briefings.tldr: US Ambassador Mike Waltz detailed a paradigm shift in American foreign policy characterized by aggressive UN budgetary reforms and the "Donroe Doctrine," prioritizing Western Hemisphere security and results-oriented "focused multilateralism" over traditional, symbolism-heavy diplomacy.

briefings.title: Vance’s ‘Enemy Within’: How the US shocked Europe into rearmament
briefings.tldr: One year after Vice President J.D. Vance’s "Munich Shock," the Transatlantic Alliance is undergoing a painful rebalancing as the U.S. shifts its focus to the Western Hemisphere, forcing European allies to choose between rapid rearmament or strategic irrelevance.

briefings.title: Watch CNBC's full interview with Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent
briefings.tldr: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced a new FinCEN whistleblower program to recover billions in fraudulent government spending while projecting that the U.S. economy is transitioning from a "table-setting" phase in 2025 to a "banquet" of growth in 2026.
